overview_description.description:
BrightBytes provides the first SaaS-based data analytics platform that measures and links technology use in education to learning outcomes. It leverages data to understand and improve learning with technology. Its team is made up of Data Scientists, Educational Researchers, Developers, and Data Visualization Experts. The platform also enables educators to cleanse, integrate, and bi-directionally to manage complex data from multiple systems. 

It was founded in 2012 and is located in San Francisco, California.

product.name: BrightBytes Platform
product.description: A cloud-based data infrastructure and analytics platform that integrates K-12 education data to provide dashboards, predictive analytics, and actionable insights for educators and administrators.

product.name: Data Integration Services
product.description: Services to connect and consolidate data from over 100 education systems into a unified, secure, and standards-aligned data warehouse for analysis.

identifier.value: Predictive Analytics and Machine Learning Models

product.name: Predictive Analytics and Machine Learning Models
product.description: Development of predictive models and algorithms using historical education data to identify trends and forecast student outcomes.

product.name: Role-Based Data Dashboards and Reporting
product.description: Customizable dashboards and reports designed for different education stakeholders to visualize and act on relevant data.

product.name: Data Leadership Coaching
product.description: Ongoing coaching services to support education leaders in adopting data-driven strategies and maximizing the use of analytics for school improvement.

product.name: API and Automation Integration
product.description: APIs and automation tools that enable integration of BrightBytes analytics data into existing education systems and workflows.
